units.source_text: K的父兄从家乡赶来时，对于把K埋在哪里，我谈了自己的意见。

en.t: When K's father and elder brother came from his hometown, I gave them my own opinion about where K should be buried.

units.source_text: K生前，我们常常一起在杂司谷一带散步，他很喜欢那一带，

en.t: While K was alive, we often walked together around Zoshigaya, and he was very fond of that area.

units.source_text: 记得我还半开玩笑地对他说过，既然你这么喜欢这里，死后就把你埋在这里吧。

en.t: I remember even saying to him half in jest that, since he liked the place so much, I would bury him there after he died.

units.source_text: 我现在还在想，即便按那时的约定，把K埋在杂司谷，也算不上积多少功德。

en.t: Even now I think that burying K in Zoshigaya according to that old promise could hardly count as any great act of merit.

units.source_text: 但是，我想在我有生之年，每个月都跪在K的墓前，重新忏悔一遍。

en.t: But for as long as I lived, I wanted to kneel before K's grave every month and renew my confession.

units.source_text: 也许是考虑到一直以来都是我在关照被他们抛弃的K的情分吧，K的父兄都采纳了我的意见。

en.t: Perhaps because they took into account that I had long been caring for the K they had cast aside, K's father and elder brother both accepted my opinion.
